name: Winterizing
summary: We drain the lines, treat the water system and get your RV ready to sit through the cold, so it’s ready to go in spring.
includes: Draining the water lines and tanks
Treating the water system so nothing freezes and splits
Getting the RV ready to sit through the winter
bring: The keys to the unit and any compartment locks
Tell us if you’ve already drained anything or added antifreeze

faq.a: Before overnight temperatures start dropping below freezing. Around Concord that’s usually late October to November. Water left in the lines can freeze and split pipes and fittings.
We don’t publish a price yet. Call the shop and we’ll tell you the price for your unit.

faq.q: Should I cover the roof and A/C for the winter?
faq.a: A cover keeps snow, ice and debris out of the A/C unit and off the roof. We offer A/C covers and roof covers; ask when you book.
